user.title: Add a vehicle
user.description: Pick a device for each role — Vehicle, Charger, Charging control, and Power price. EV Ledger finds every sensor it needs from the device itself. Leave a picker empty to leave that role out entirely. Turn on 'Advanced setup' to review or override every sensor by hand instead.

data.zaptec_device_id: Charger (optional — leave empty if you don't have one)
data.monta_device_id: Charging control (optional — leave empty if you don't have one)
data.spot_price_device_id: Power price (optional — leave empty if you don't have one)
data.battery_capacity_kwh: Usable battery capacity in kWh (only used if model is 'Custom')
data.rated_wh_per_km: Rated consumption in Wh/km (only used if model is 'Custom')
data.advanced_setup: Advanced setup — show every sensor field so I can review or override them

fill_missing.title: Review sensors
fill_missing.description: Either something couldn't be found automatically, or you turned on advanced setup — either way, everything shown here is editable. Anything already found is pre-filled; just correct what needs it.

data.outside_temp_entity: Outside temperature sensor (optional, enables efficiency-vs-temperature tracking)

init.title: Reconfigure EV Ledger
init.description: One page for everything currently configured. Clear a Zaptec/Monta/price entity to drop that provider entirely.

data.outside_temp_entity: Outside temperature sensor (optional, enables efficiency-vs-temperature tracking)
data.zaptec_power_entity: Zaptec charge power sensor (optional — leave empty to drop Zaptec)
data.zaptec_session_energy_entity: Zaptec session energy sensor (optional — leave empty to drop Zaptec)
data.zaptec_charging_entity: Zaptec charging (binary sensor or switch, optional)
data.monta_last_charge_entity: Monta last charge sensor (optional — leave empty to drop Monta)
data.spot_price_entity: Electricity price sensor (optional — leave empty to drop spot-price estimates)
data.battery_capacity_kwh: Usable battery capacity in kWh (only used if model is 'Custom')
data.rated_wh_per_km: Rated consumption in Wh/km (only used if model is 'Custom')
